description: This Java class 'ActionBarHandler' extends 'ActionBarCallback' and provides functionality related to the Android Action Bar, including menu handling, navigation mode, and home button style, for use within the Android Studio rendering environment.

classes.name: ActionBarHandler
classes.description: A callback class that provides information and controls related to the Android Action Bar for rendering purposes.

methods.name: getSplitActionBarWhenNarrow
methods.description: Determines if the action bar should be split when the screen is narrow based on activity attributes.

methods.name: isShowingMenu
methods.description: Returns whether the menu is currently shown.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the menu and triggers a re-render if needed.

methods.name: isOverflowPopupNeeded
methods.description: Indicates if an overflow popup is needed based on menu visibility or resource folder type.

methods.name: getMenuIdNames
methods.description: Retrieves the list of menu IDs, parsing from XML or associated class methods.

methods.name: getHomeButtonStyle
methods.description: Determines the style of the home button based on activity attributes.

methods.name: getNavigationMode
methods.description: Returns the navigation mode (tabs, list, standard) based on XML attributes.

methods.name: setMenuIdNames
methods.description: Sets the list of menu ID names.

methods.name: getActivityAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves activity attributes from the manifest info.
